entries.brief: A human hand and partial side profile merge smoothly into one chunky gray rock, half human skin half unbroken natural stone, no trapped screaming face or petrification cracks, inward merging gesture. Full-color original SKAZ fantasy handbook painted icon. Bold broad shapes, dark defined contours, warm ochre highlights, cool slate shadows, restrained glow. A compact central motif occupying only65 percent square canvas, empty transparent margin on all sides. No text, digits, border, circular background or UI. Transparent PNG.

review.notes: Local IAB32/40px, grayscale circle, Polaris/Coal/Atlas. Six distinct silhouettes inspected in all themes, including pale Phantom Steed on Atlas.
